# Statement blocks of the rendering head that no test in cmd/dinah executes.
#
# TestEveryStatementOfTheRenderingHeadIsCoveredOrNamed reads this file. Every
# entry is a place the output check does not look, so an entry is a finding
# rather than a line of configuration: it says a block prints for a reader and
# nothing in the suite has ever read what it prints. Two assertions keep the
# pressure on. An entry naming a block the suite does execute fails, so a stale
# entry is pruned rather than left to accumulate, and an entry carrying no
# reason fails, so nobody adds one without saying why the block is unreached.
#
# A line is the block, then whitespace, then the reason. A blank line and a
# line opening with a hash are commentary.
#
# Two kinds of entry sit here and the difference is worth reading. Some blocks
# cannot be reached from a test at all, and say so. The rest are reachable and
# simply unreached: each is a human rendering the suite has never printed, and
# each is worth a test rather than a permanent line here.

help.go:169.32,171.3  verbHelp refusing a command it does not know, which helpFor settles before composing anything, so no invocation reaches it whether the help command or a help flag asked.
render.go:54.29,56.27  the stale outcome of a response, which the cli head cannot provoke: a stale revision needs a second writer between the read and the act.
render.go:56.27,58.4  the same, on the branch where the stale response carries a card.
render.go:59.3,59.102  the same, writing the stale sentence.
render.go:60.10,61.108  the unreachable outcome, which is by construction the outcome no invocation produces.
render.go:70.16,73.3  the branch where the machine form will not marshal, which needs a value the library cannot build.
render.go:143.19,145.3  a token the catalog carries no rendering for, and every token the head prints has one.
render.go:255.29,258.3  the sentence a listing prints when the state holds no card. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:465.23,468.3  a card carrying a body, printed under its own line by show. Reachable and unreached: worth a test.
render.go:687.23,689.4  the states listing asked for before a workbench is open, which unknown-state cannot be raised before.
render.go:730.18,732.3  the composer's fallback for a refusal name no shape declares, which the source-side guard fails a build over, so no invocation reaches it.
render.go:783.23,785.3  a composition splicing no fragment at all, which needs a shape offering no next step, and every shape offers one.
render.go:811.2,811.11  the alternation answering with nothing, which needs a last member carrying a condition, and the guard fails a shape whose last member does.
render.go:937.23,939.3  renderWorkstreamLine handed no workstream, which emitWorkstream cannot produce: it draws the line only on an ok outcome, and every ok outcome of the two workstream acts carries the workstream it wrote.
render.go:969.22,971.3  workstreamRef reading a session that has opened no workbench, which no card line reaches: a card line is drawn from a response, and there is no response until a workbench is open.
help.go:264.9,266.3  vocabularyValues giving up on a vocabulary source no listing answers to, which TestEveryVocabularySourceHasAListingThatAnswersIt refuses, so no declared source reaches it.
table.go:249.30,251.3  the shipped binary's branch, where no test hook is armed. The suite arms the recorder for its whole run, so this is unreachable from a test by construction.
